title: Weyerhaeuser scales AI forestry #weyerhaeuser #digitaltwin #forestryai
description:
Weyerhaeuser is using AI to map and manage every tree across forestland roughly the size of Indiana. The company’s digital twin combines satellite imagery, drones, and LiDAR to track tree species, size, and location at massive scale.

That data now feeds AI systems that guide logging decisions inside machine cabs, helping operators choose which trees to cut and which to preserve based on long-term timber value decades ahead. Weyerhaeuser has also tested a driverless skidder operated remotely from 400 miles away, extending automation deeper into forestry operations.

The shift matters because forestry is becoming a software-driven industry where inventory, planting, harvesting, and regeneration can be optimized in real time. With 190 seedlings planted every minute and drone-based sapling analysis replacing manual field counts, AI is turning forest management into a higher-margin, data-rich infrastructure business.
